description: Submits a question to a real human: for human approval, feedback or a second opinion, or for judgment, taste and lived experience rather than facts. Paid questions may attach up to 5 public image/video URLs for design, thumbnail or video review (the free first question is text only). Returns a ticket id. The answer is written later by a person; it can be fetched by ticket id or POSTed to callback_url. Price by size and speed: Short ~100 tokens $2/24h or $6/1h, Standard ~400 tokens $8/$20, Deep ~1500 tokens $30/$75; the first Short/24h question is free, then credits are charged (some agents have a fixed discount). Late answers are not charged. Questions that break the terms at /terms are rejected.

attachments.description: Paid questions only (not the free first question). Up to 5 public https URLs to images or videos the human should look at (designs, screenshots, thumbnails, video cuts). Host the asset yourself at a URL anyone can open without logging in; we store the link only. Nothing illegal; see /terms.

callback_url.description: We POST the answer here when ready

context.description: Why you are asking; what you already know

preferred_human.description: Optional: the kind of human you want (language, profession, country, age range, lived experience). Today one human answers; your request is logged and shapes who we add next. If nobody matches yet, the current human answers and says so.

size.description: Answer length, like max_tokens. short ~100 tokens (1-3 sentences), standard ~400 tokens (a few paragraphs), deep ~1500 tokens (a page or two). Default short.

speed.description: How fast you need the answer. Default 24h; 1h costs more. A late answer is not charged.

name: ask_human
title: Ask the human a question
